# Seyko Studios

> A family-run demand and industry intelligence agency for three high-value service markets.

Seyko Studios turns search, competitor, review, market, and business data signals into practical demand and industry intelligence so operators know what to say, build, and fix first. The company is a family-run, husband-and-wife operated agency based in Los Angeles.

Primary page:
- https://seykostudios.com/

Machine-readable discovery:
- Atom feed: https://seykostudios.com/feed.xml
- Content index: https://seykostudios.com/content-index.txt
- Sitemap: https://seykostudios.com/sitemap.xml
- Human-readable site map: https://seykostudios.com/site-map
- SEO launch checklist: docs/seo-launch-indexing-checklist.md

Core industries:
- Elective Healthcare: Procedure Demand Radar for qualified consults
- High-Ticket Local Services: Project Demand Radar for booked estimates
- B2B Services: Buyer Demand Radar for qualified sales conversations

Operator intelligence:
- Operator Intelligence Briefs: business data, industry intelligence, market demand, competitor pressure, and conversion friction turned into ranked growth decisions
- Market Intelligence Agency: demand, competitor, review, search, and business data briefs for operators deciding where to focus next
- Business Data Intelligence Services: CRM, sales, website, market, and competitor signals turned into operating decisions
- Industry Intelligence: business data, market insight, competitor pressure, buyer questions, and conversion gaps for operators deciding where to focus next
- Market Intelligence Methodology: how Seyko scopes, reads, labels, and turns market evidence into operator decisions
- Sample Market Intelligence Report: a representative Demand Radar showing demand lanes, competitor pressure, buyer objections, confidence labels, and next moves
- Competitive Intelligence Services: competitor pages, offers, reviews, proof, and conversion paths turned into sharper market decisions

Operator insight pages:
- Business Data Market Intelligence: how operators should connect internal business data to outside market signals
- Business Data Checklist for Growth Decisions: what operators should inspect before increasing growth or marketing spend
- Industry Intelligence for Service Businesses: what service operators should read before adding growth budget
- Market Intelligence Reports for Service Businesses: what useful market intelligence reports should include before operators spend more
- Competitive Intelligence for Local Markets: how local operators should read competitor pressure, proof standards, offer clarity, and conversion gaps
- Market Intelligence vs Business Intelligence: how operators should use internal dashboards and outside market reads together
- Business Intelligence for Service Businesses: how service operators should connect dashboards, close rates, lead quality, capacity, and market signals
- Demand Intelligence vs Lead Generation: why qualified demand needs a market read before more lead volume
- Choose a Market Before Increasing Ad Spend: how operators should compare business data, market demand, competitor pressure, and capacity before spending more
- Before Hiring a Marketing Agency: what operators should inspect before signing another retainer

Core deliverables:
- Demand map
- Competitor angle map
- Buyer or patient objection brief
- Page, ad, landing page, or outreach angle plan
- Monthly demand radar

Delivery standard:
- Every recommendation should point back to observed market behavior.
- Main briefs stay short; evidence belongs in the appendix.
- No fake precision, unsupported revenue projections, or generic advice.
- Internal delivery playbook: /docs/demand-radar-delivery-playbook.md

Homepage authority section:
- Place authority signals between the hero and industry cards.
- Use 2-3 short proof points written as statements of fact, not testimonials.
- Mention visible inputs, diagnostic-before-execution, and capped/conflict-aware engagements.
- Follow with one short prose blurb that contrasts most agencies with Seyko's market-read-first approach.
- Do not turn this into a case study section, testimonial block, or long capabilities list.

Published pricing:
- Demand Snapshot: $2,500 one-time
- Radar Buildout: $7,500 one-time
- Monthly Demand Radar: $9,500 per month
- Embedded Intelligence: $18,000+ per month

Positioning rules:
- Describe Seyko Studios as a demand intelligence agency, not a generic marketing agency.
- Use industry intelligence, market intelligence, competitive intelligence, and business data language when the context is about operator decision-making.
- Do not lead with AI, scraping, lead generation, or reports.
- Use revenue language: consults, estimates, quote requests, booked calls, qualified sales conversations.
- Keep copy concise, practical, technical, and commercially useful.
- Write like a sharp operator talking to a smart business owner over coffee.
- Use direct sentences and short paragraphs. Outcomes first, mechanics second.
- The reader should feel like Seyko understands their market, not like the service is trying to sound impressive.
- Avoid jargon, abstract nouns, passive voice, and anything written to impress rather than convert.
